Bihar BSEB DElEd 3rd Merit List 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar School Examination Board, Patna (BSEB) has released the 3rd Merit List for the BSEB Bihar D.El.Ed, Examination for Admission In Diploma In Elementary Education (D.El.Ed) For Two Years Course Program For Session 2026-28. Applications for the BSEB Bihar D.El.Ed Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 11 December 2025, to 24 January 2026. The written examination was held on 08-22 June 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their BSEB Bihar D.El.Ed 3rd Merit List 2026-28 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 11 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 11 December 2025
  • Last Date : 24 January 2026 (Extend)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 January 2026
  • 1st Dummy Admit Card Available : 28 January 2026
  • 1st Dummy Admit Card Correction : 28 January to 02 February 2026
  • 2nd Dummy Admit Card Available : 05 February 2026
  • 2nd Dummy Admit Card Correction : 05-10 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 08-22 January 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 28 May 2026
  • Answer Key Available : 02 July 2026
  • Result : 06 August 2026
  • CAF : 10-16 August 2026
  • 1st Merit List : 27 August 2026
  • 2nd Merit List : 05 September 2026
  • 2nd Merit List Admission Period : 05 to 08 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, BC, EBC : Rs. 960/-
  • SC, ST, Divyang : Rs. 760/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
